import unittest
from copy import deepcopy
from codec import parse_event
from reducer import empty_state, apply_event
from checkpoint import dump_state, load_state


def build_state():
    st = empty_state()
    st = apply_event(st, parse_event('{"id":"r1","op":"restock","sku":"A","qty":5}'))
    st = apply_event(st, parse_event('{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",2]]}'))
    st = apply_event(st, parse_event('{"id":"c1","op":"cancel","request":"Q"}'))
    return st


class CheckpointTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_roundtrip_preserves_state(self):
        st = build_state()
        text = dump_state(st)
        loaded = load_state(text)
        self.assertEqual(loaded, st)
        self.assertEqual(set(loaded), {'stock', 'requests', 'seen'})

    def test_dump_has_exact_format(self):
        st = empty_state()
        text = dump_state(st)
        self.assertTrue(text.endswith('\n'))
        self.assertEqual(text.count('\n'), 1)
        # sort_keys => keys sorted
        self.assertIn('"state":{"requests":{},"seen":{},"stock":{}}', text)
        self.assertIn('"version":1', text)
        self.assertNotIn(' ', text[:-1])  # no spaces from separators

    def test_load_accepts_surrounding_whitespace(self):
        st = build_state()
        text = dump_state(st)
        loaded = load_state('  \n' + text + ' \n ')
        self.assertEqual(loaded, st)

    def test_equal_states_different_insertion_order_same_text(self):
        st1 = empty_state()
        st1 = apply_event(st1, parse_event('{"id":"r1","op":"restock","sku":"A","qty":1}'))
        st1 = apply_event(st1, parse_event('{"id":"r2","op":"restock","sku":"B","qty":2}'))
        # Build equivalent state with different stock insertion order
        st2 = empty_state()
        st2 = apply_event(st2, parse_event('{"id":"r2","op":"restock","sku":"B","qty":2}'))
        st2 = apply_event(st2, parse_event('{"id":"r1","op":"restock","sku":"A","qty":1}'))
        self.assertEqual(st1, st2)
        self.assertEqual(dump_state(st1), dump_state(st2))

    def test_reject_boolean_quantity_in_stock(self):
        st = empty_state()
        st['stock']['A'] = True
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dump_state(st)

    def test_reject_float_quantity_in_requests(self):
        st = empty_state()
        st['requests']['Q'] = {'A': 1.0}
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dump_state(st)

    def test_reject_bad_version(self):
        st = empty_state()
        text = dump_state(st)
        wrapped = text.replace('"version":1', '"version":true')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            load_state(wrapped)

    def test_reject_extra_wrapper_key(self):
        st = empty_state()
        text = dump_state(st).rstrip('\n')
        wrapped = text[:-1] + ',"extra":1}'
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            load_state(wrapped)

    def test_reject_duplicate_keys_in_state(self):
        st = empty_state()
        text = dump_state(st).rstrip('\n')
        # craft duplicate stock key
        bad = '{"version":1,"state":{"stock":{"A":1,"A":2},"requests":{},"seen":{}}}'
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            load_state(bad)

    def test_rejects_reordered_reserve_seen(self):
        st = empty_state()
        st = apply_event(st, parse_event(
            '{"id":"v","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",1],["B",2]]}'))
        # tamper seen to reorder lines
        st2 = deepcopy(st)
        st2['seen']['v']['lines'] = [['B', 2], ['A', 1]]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dump_state(st2)

    def test_rejects_unaggregated_reserve_seen(self):
        st = empty_state()
        st = apply_event(st, parse_event(
            '{"id":"v","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",1]]}'))
        st2 = deepcopy(st)
        st2['seen']['v']['lines'] = [['A', 1], ['A', 2]]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dump_state(st2)

    def test_load_does_not_mutate_input(self):
        st = build_state()
        text = dump_state(st)
        before = text
        load_state(text)
        self.assertEqual(text, before)

    def test_load_result_detached(self):
        st = build_state()
        loaded = load_state(dump_state(st))
        loaded['stock']['NEW'] = 1
        self.assertNotIn('NEW', st['stock'])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
